transcript:
MARTIN: Anything interesting with the typewriters?

[SFX: footsteps]

DAVID: Meh...

[SFX: He presses a couple of the keys which clack loudly.]

DAVID: Nah. No paper in them. Way too dark to read what's left on the rollers.

[SFX, INTERRUPTING: same 'new email' sound on Martin's PC as act 1]

DAVID: So soon? Can't be any worse than the last commercial!

[SFX: Martin's mouse clicking]

MARTIN: No... It's just a bunch of random letters... That's weird...
